name: Sunteck Realty Ltd
title: Sunteck Realty Ltd - 512179 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Presales up 25% to INR3,157 crore and FY27 growth guided at similar ~25%, with BD spend rising to over INR800 crore and no discounts claimed; supply-side signals are expansionary, not disciplined.

capex.quote: We have invested INR8.1 billion in full year of FY '26 compared to INR1.8 billion for full year of FY '25.

triggers.label: BD spend INR200 cr → INR800 cr+
triggers.quote: this year we have done more than INR800 crores -- we are obviously looking at our cash flow

triggers.label: FY27 presales growth similar ~25%
triggers.quote: we remain very confident of sustaining similar growth, I can say

triggers.label: Footfalls down 5-10% in last month
triggers.quote: Footfalls, I can say definitely must have dropped by 5%, 10% for sure.

triggers.label: Management sees limited price rise
triggers.quote: we should not expect too much of price rise from here

guidance.quote: we are very, very confident about our growth of the whatever we have done in the current year, similar growth of 25% in the coming year as well.

guidance.metric: Blended EBITDA margin on new projects
guidance.quote: So recently signed project, you can say, 30%, 35% margins and blended will be close to 35% to 40%.
close to approximately INR7,000 crores of GDV.

prior_guidance_check.quote: This strong performance reaffirms the guidance we had shared at the start of the year.

red_flags.label: Dubai project launch delayed by war
red_flags.quote: So the project is launch-ready for us. And whenever we see the event settling down.
